name: Jiangsu Zhongli Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Zhongli Group Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells cables and photovoltaic products in China and internationally. It operates through cable and photovoltaic segments. It provides power, wind, control, data, marine, mine, rail transit, photoelectric composite, electronic line of certification, automobile, board coaxial, communication, and aluminum alloy cables, as well as overhead conductors and steel core aluminum standard wires.
